name: Existing per-vertex cortical curvature and sulcal morphometry distribution analysis
purpose: Describe distributions of existing per-vertex cortical curvature and sulcal morphometry, preserving generator, smoothing, units and definitions; do not equate precomputed FreeSurfer sulc with a different alpha-surface distance method.

steps.statement: Generate distribution plots (e.g., histograms) of the per-vertex values to describe their spread.
steps.quote: All scripts generated for this study, including code sufficient to reproduce all figures, are available at https://github.com/mholla/NIMG23.

checks.statement: Confirm that the surfaces have been smoothed and topology-corrected before using the morphometry values.
checks.quote: Resmooth RH/LH white matter: smooths rh.orig and lh.orig surfaces

outputs.statement: Descriptive statistics and distribution plots of the per-vertex curvature and sulcal values.
outputs.quote: we analyzed the patterns of cortical thickness and folding for each species with respect to size (surface area), geometry (curvature, shape, and sulcal depth)

claim.statement: FreeSurfer morphometry files (e.g., ?h.curv, ?h.sulc, ?h.thickness) containing per-vertex values.
claim.quote: read_morph_data(filepath) ... Read a Freesurfer morphometry data file.

claim.statement: FreeSurfer surface geometry files (e.g., ?h.white, ?h.pial) for vertex coordinates and faces.
claim.quote: read_geometry(filepath[, read_metadata, ...]) Read a triangular format Freesurfer surface mesh.

claim.statement: FreeSurfer annotation files (e.g., ?h.aparc.annot) for parcellation labels if needed.
claim.quote: read_annot(filepath[, orig_ids]) Read in a Freesurfer annotation from a .annot file.

claim.statement: Morphometry files are in FreeSurfer 'curv' format, which may include curvature or sulcal depth values.
claim.quote: This function reads in what Freesurfer internally calls “curv” file types, (e.g. ?h. curv, ?h.thickness)

claim.statement: The sulc file is generated by FreeSurfer's surface processing pipeline and represents sulcal depth, not an alpha-surface distance.
Curvature and sulcal values are per-vertex and derived from the reconstructed surfaces after smoothing and topology correction.
claim.quote: Resmooth RH/LH white matter: smooths rh.orig and lh.orig surfaces ... curv ... rh.curv ... rh.sulc

claim.statement: Load the FreeSurfer morphometry file using nibabel's read_morph_data to obtain per-vertex values.
claim.quote: read_morph_data(filepath) ... Returns: curv numpy array Vector representation of surface morpometry values

claim.statement: Load the corresponding surface geometry with read_geometry to get vertex coordinates and faces.
claim.quote: read_geometry(filepath[, read_metadata, ...]) ... Returns: coords numpy array nvtx x 3 array of vertex (x, y, z) coordinates. faces numpy array nfaces x 3 array of defining mesh triangles.

claim.statement: Optionally load annotation file with read_annot to associate vertices with cortical labels.
claim.quote: read_annot(filepath[, orig_ids]) ... Returns: labels ndarray, shape (n_vertices,) Annotation id at each vertex.

claim.statement: Compute descriptive statistics (e.g., mean, standard deviation, percentiles) of the per-vertex curvature and sulcal values.
claim.quote: we used our surface-based computational pipeline ... to analyze patterns of cortical thickness and folding with respect to size (total surface area), geometry (i.e. curvature, shape, and sulcal depth)

claim.statement: Verify that the morphometry file is in FreeSurfer 'curv' format and not another format.
claim.quote: read_morph_data(filepath) ... This function reads in what Freesurfer internally calls “curv” file types

claim.statement: Ensure that the sulc values are interpreted as FreeSurfer sulcal depth, not as a distance from an alpha surface.
If the morphometry file is not in FreeSurfer 'curv' format, read_morph_data may fail or return incorrect values.
claim.quote: read_morph_data(filepath) ... This function reads in what Freesurfer internally calls “curv” file types

claim.statement: The sulc file should not be equated with an alpha-surface distance method; it is a FreeSurfer-specific measure.
A vector of per-vertex morphometry values (e.g., curvature or sulcal depth) from the input file.
claim.quote: Returns: curv numpy array Vector representation of surface morpometry values

claim.statement: Vertex coordinates and face indices of the associated surface mesh.
claim.quote: Returns: coords numpy array nvtx x 3 array of vertex (x, y, z) coordinates. faces numpy array nfaces x 3 array of defining mesh triangles.

claim.statement: orig_ids: whether to return vertex ids as stored in annotation file or positional colortable ids.
claim.quote: orig_idsbool Whether to return the vertex ids as stored in the annotation file or the positional colortable ids.

claim.statement: read_metadata: whether to read and return metadata from the geometry file.
claim.quote: read_metadatabool, optional If True, read and return metadata as key-value pairs.

claim.statement: read_stamp: whether to return the comment from the geometry file.
claim.quote: read_stampbool, optional Return the comment from the file
